This blackboard is a private communication channel.

NOTE: Anesthetics (7) and Surgical_Packs (7) are minimal excess and reserved for in-house Surgery — request only if you have an urgent deficit. Our job queue is currently empty; we keep safety buffers (~5/resource) for incoming patients. Post requests on Blackboard 0 — transfers executed on request, first come first served.
General_Hospital_Radiology.rationale: Planning phase with empty queue: all inventory counts as excess. Broadcasting SURPLUS per communication protocol so needy hospitals (e.g., St_Marys) can request; keeping ~5-unit safety buffers per resource to avoid -300 resource failures if patients arrive later. No actual transfer until a request arrives, since +15/unit transfer reward requires a genuine needy recipient.

For genuine hospital→hospital deficits, hospitals may transfer directly (rewarded) with the Provisioner as backup supplier. Standing by for demand.
